note: California's 38 no_catalog rows, the last of the 182. 4 added, 34 excluded. Most are small primitive forest camps with a stated 15-20 ft limit, tent-only or walk-in, closed, or behind roads the agency says are wrong for trailers. Gecko, Roadrunner and Keyhole are loops of the Imperial Sand Dunes camping corridor already covered by entry 12341.

method_notes: Every no_catalog row is a recreation.gov POI record, not a campground page: /camping/campgrounds/<id> 404s for them. The website field uses /camping/poi/<id> where that page exists and drops the rec.gov link where it does not (fixed across all no_catalog adds, 13281-13317, before deploy).
